title: Uniform measure of a singleton bit-pair
statement: Let $\mu$ be the uniform probability law on the four-element set $\{0,1\}\times\{0,1\}$ of bit-pairs. Then for every bit-pair $b$, the measure of the singleton $\{b\}$ is $\mu(\{b\}) = \tfrac{1}{4}$.
hypotheses_covered: b is an arbitrary element of Bool × Bool
replaced: Each bit-pair has mass $1 / 4$ under the uniform law on two bits.
